exposure: mode of conception (spontaneous vs. infertility treatment)
cohort: Women who underwent LSCS over a period of 11 months at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of Patna medical College and Hospital, Patna, Bihar, India (n=500).
finding: The LSCS rate was 53.47%, with the most common indication being previous LSCS (42%), followed by failure of induction of labor (24%).
gest_age: 5% of LSCS occurred at <32 weeks, 25% between 32-36 weeks, and 70% between 37-40 weeks.
